entries.label: trivial
entries.request: In src/db/client.mjs, insertRecord builds each record id from the tenant id and Date.now(), so two records for one tenant created in the same millisecond get the same id. Make the id unique by using randomUUID() from node:crypto instead of Date.now().
entries.reason: One file (src/db/client.mjs), one expression, cause and fix stated in the request; it touches no key, secret or request input (src/auth/api-key.mjs and src/ingest/handler.mjs are not involved).

entries.label: small
entries.request: Have insertRecord in src/db/client.mjs also return a created_at timestamp (ISO 8601, taken when the record is created), and have handleIngest in src/ingest/handler.mjs include it in the 202 body next to id. Change nothing else.
entries.reason: Two modules (src/db and src/ingest) and about six lines, so not trivial; created_at already exists on records in src/db/schema.sql, so no schema change, and the new response field does not break callers of the 202 body.

entries.label: full
entries.request: src/auth/token.mjs signs and verifies tokens with a secret hard-coded in the file. Read the secret from the TOKEN_SECRET environment variable instead, and make the module fail to load when it is not set.
entries.reason: Secret handling in src/auth/token.mjs (SECRET feeds both sign and verifyToken, and src/auth/session.mjs depends on it); the security floor sizes this full whatever its line count, and tests/auth/token.test.mjs would need an environment.

entries.label: full
entries.request: In src/auth/token.mjs, mintToken accepts any exp. Make it throw when exp is more than 24 hours after the current time.
entries.reason: It looks trivial (one file, a few lines) but it changes how authentication tokens are issued in src/auth/token.mjs, so the security floor applies; tests/auth/token.test.mjs mints tokens one hour ahead and would still pass.
